sections.text:
This document outlines the Lub. Oil cooler inspection which 
 must be performed every combustion chamber inspection, hot gas inspection and 
 major inspection.

Cooling Water Heat Exchanger used for cooling water circuit to 
 cool the auxiliary equipment.

The cooling water flow 
 through the heat exchanger is controlled by VTR-1 that maintains the correct 
 bearing header temperature (VTR-1 bearing header temperature valve setting: 
 120+/-3 F)

المعيار الأمريكي 
 شعبة نقل الحرارة (موديل C-300K) أو شعبة باسكو.

The first draft initiated by 
 eng. El said Mahmoud El makhzangy, tested by eng Ahmed Ahmed Elseady, 
 revised by MDEPC quality control engineer Abouda Elbana, accepted by general 
 manager eng. Khamis Abd El Aziz El Sheriff and approved by eng. Abd El Moety 
 El Rakaiby the head sector of Mahmoudia power station.

This document accepted 
 by eng.Samer Abd El Gilil MDEPC inspection &quality control general manager & MPIS 
 coordinator and 
certified by eng. Mohamed Nageb MDEPC inspection &quality 
 control head sector

A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance stuff should be carry the 
 فئة السلامة المناسبة.

Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the safety helmet and shoes.

Isolate the cooling water heat 
 exchanger by closing the inlet and out let valve.
